content.comment_body: Hello everyone, according to the [product_name] data sheet and price list, it should be possible to use up to four analog outputs, but in [product_name] Comfort, I can only set up two. Am I missing something? Thank you for any help. Best regards, [user_name]
Where did this information come from? [product_name] modules only support two analog outputs in single mode.
I received this information via email from my [company_name] sales representative.
Check out this brochure: [url] It contains the latest details about [product_name] [article_no] versions.
Hello, A single [product_name] supports only two analog outputs. The brochure you have is inaccurate on this aspect.

I've worked with [product_name] for 4-5 years, and after reviewing the newest brochure I posted earlier, I believed that having four analog outputs was enabled in the latest software. It turns out I was mistaken. Thanks for your feedback. A very disappointed [user_name]
My [company_name] contact just confirmed the July 2011 brochure contains a typo.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is frustrated due to marketing materials stating four analog outputs are supported, while in reality the product allows only two. This causes confusion and disappointment as documentation from official sources does not match the actual product capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to configure up to four analog outputs in [product_name] modules because that's what is advertised in the documentation and stated by company representatives.
